name: Shahu I
profileSummary: Shahu I was the fifth Chhatrapati of Maratha Empire from 1708 to 1749, the longest reign among the Maratha rulers. He was also the last subahdar of the Bijapur Subah, before being annexed by the Maratha Empire. During Shahu's reign, the Maratha Empire expanded across much of the Indian subcontinent and emerged as one of the leading powers in South Asia.
